plan.title: Block surrogate overwrite of vendor bid

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on its Participants tab, where the vendor's existing bid and Add Bid control can be evaluated.
Disable surrogate revisions after a vendor's own bid.
Enable the eRFX project flow required by the case.
Locate the vendor whose own bid is already present.
Confirm Vendor A is on the round and no surrogate Add Bid action is available because it already bid.
Attempt the buyer-side surrogate bid and require positive evidence that Procol refuses to overwrite the vendor's own bid.
